description: Get one voucher (Beleg) by its sevDesk id with its positions (Belegpositionen): per position net, tax and gross amount, tax rate and booking account (Buchungskonto: accountDatev id in Update 2.0, accountingType id in legacy 1.0 positions), plus the voucher's tax rule (Steuerregel) or legacy tax type, dates, status and payment direction. Old and new bookkeeping generations are shown per record, also when mixed. Use it after sevdesk_vouchers_list, e.g. to see how a supplier's earlier receipts were booked.
name: sevdesk_voucher_get
title: Get a sevDesk voucher
